description: External skills/plugins/MCPs that dev-pipeline references. Used by /dev-pipeline:refresh-deps to verify presence + freshness AND by /dev-pipeline:skill-doctor to diagnose drift. Names here SHOULD match the actual plugin/skill `name` on disk; if upstream renamed, list the old name(s) under `supersedes[]`. Each entry should carry a `marketplaceHint` pointing to the marketplace name in `marketplaces[]` so refresh-deps can suggest where to install missing items.

marketplaces.name: developer-kit
marketplaces.note: Community marketplace. Enable selectively via settings.json after review.

marketplaces.name: fullstack-dev-skills
marketplaces.note: Community marketplace — 66 skills as one plugin (api-designer, websocket-engineer, nextjs-developer, nestjs-expert, typescript-pro, security-reviewer, etc.). Enable via settings.json after review.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.fallback: owned reviewers (deep + typescript + security) still run

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.note: Vercel plugin — ships 30+ skills including react-best-practices, shadcn, nextjs, ai-sdk, vercel-cli, vercel-storage, etc. Source: https://github.com/vercel/vercel-plugin

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.trigger: UI/design phase (Phase 3) — installed default spec generator
skills.note: Default executed design-spec generator when ui-ux-pro-max is absent (Phase 3.3). Aesthetic-direction layer; composes with (not replaced by) the two below.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.trigger: UI/design phase (Phase 3.3) — preferred spec generator when installed
skills.note: Design-intelligence database (styles/palettes/font pairings/UX rules; BM25 search, needs python3). Source: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill (verified 2026-07: active, v2.11).

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.fallback: Phase 3.4 applies its checklist areas inline (WCAG AA, states, responsive)
skills.note: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines audit (100+ file:line rules, fetches latest rules). Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills.

skills.name: playwright-expert
skills.trigger: writing E2E tests or debugging flaky browser tests
skills.note: Use for writing Playwright specs, Page Object Models, selectors, fixtures. Authoritative source for E2E patterns — referenced from commands/deliver.md PHASE 10.5 (browser E2E gate) so spec authors don't reinvent best practices per-feature.

skills.name: test-master
skills.trigger: test strategy, coverage analysis, test framework design
skills.note: Broader test strategy: unit/integration/E2E architecture, coverage gaps, flakiness debugging.

skills.name: verification
skills.trigger: verify full user story (browser + API + data + env)
skills.note: Vercel-plugin skill. Fires on `pnpm dev` / `next dev` etc. Verifies full flow rather than just unit-level correctness. Pairs with playwright-expert for the formal E2E layer.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.note: Anthropic skill in claude-plugins-public/skills repo. Lower-priority alternative when playwright-expert / test-master not enabled.

skills.name: react-best-practices
skills.note: Ships inside the vercel plugin at skills/react-best-practices/. Triggered automatically when editing TSX components. Pinned as the React/Next best-practice source by skill-router → Best-Practice Source Routing (invoke as vercel:react-best-practices).

skills.name: typescript-best-practices
skills.trigger: typescript detected (best-practice source — any TS/JS project)
skills.note: User-level standalone skill at ~/.claude/skills/typescript-best-practices/ (no marketplace container — installed directly). Pinned as the TS best-practice source by skill-router → Best-Practice Source Routing; fallback when absent: typescript-pro (fullstack-dev-skills), else Context7.

skills.name: drizzle-orm-patterns
skills.note: Best-practice source for Drizzle schema/queries. Fallback: Context7 drizzle-orm.

skills.name: better-auth
skills.note: Best-practice source for better-auth flows; primes the security-reviewer when pinned. Fallback: Context7 better-auth.

skills.name: zod-validation-utilities
skills.note: Best-practice source for Zod validation. Fallback: Context7 zod.

skills.name: turborepo-monorepo
skills.note: Best-practice source for Turborepo monorepos. Fallback: Context7 turborepo.

skills.name: better-t-stack
skills.trigger: bts.jsonc marker at repo root, or hono + @trpc/server + drizzle-orm dependency combo
skills.note: No meta-skill exists in any configured marketplace (checked 2026-07). Route per component instead (skill-router → Best-Practice Source Routing): drizzle-orm-patterns + better-auth covered by developer-kit-typescript; hono / trpc / orpc / tanstack-* have NO published skill yet → Context7 fallback. If an upstream better-t-stack skill appears, /dev-pipeline:skill-doctor search mode should surface it — wire it into the router table then.

skills.name: shadcn
skills.note: Ships inside the vercel plugin. Covers composition patterns, custom registries, theming. Closest match for the old 'vercel-composition-patterns'.

skills.name: nestjs-best-practices
skills.note: Exact name match — ships in developer-kit/plugins/developer-kit-typescript/skills/nestjs-best-practices/. Plugin lives at https://github.com/giuseppe-trisciuoglio/developer-kit.

skills.name: nestjs
skills.note: Replaces 'nestjs-modules'. Ships in developer-kit-typescript with sibling skills nestjs-code-review, nestjs-drizzle-crud-generator.

skills.name: typescript-pro
skills.note: Replaces 'mastering-typescript'. Part of Jeffallan/claude-skills (66 skills bundled as one plugin).

skills.name: websocket-engineer
skills.note: Exact name match in Jeffallan/claude-skills.

skills.name: architecture-designer
skills.note: Replaces 'nodejs-architecture'. Part of Jeffallan/claude-skills.

skills.name: database-optimizer
skills.note: Replaces 'nodejs-database-orm'. Sibling: developer-kit-typescript/drizzle-orm-patterns for Drizzle-specific guidance.

skills.name: test-master
skills.note: Replaces 'nodejs-testing'. Part of Jeffallan/claude-skills. Sibling: playwright-expert.

skills.name: security-reviewer
skills.note: Replaces 'nodejs-security'. Sibling: secure-code-guardian. developer-kit-typescript/typescript-security-review is a stricter TS variant.

skills.name: nodejs-caching-redis
skills.note: No exact upstream match found yet. Closest: vercel/runtime-cache (different scope). Author owned skill or accept gap.

skills.name: nodejs-docker-production
skills.note: No exact upstream match. spec-forge ships a dockerfile-deploy integration that covers production Dockerfile authoring; not a Claude Code skill though.

skills.name: nodejs-error-handling
skills.note: No exact upstream match. May be folded into a general 'backend-best-practices' skill in a future plugin.

hybridSkills.compatNote: skill-router routes TO these public skills by name. After every public-skill update, re-check the routing table for renames/removals.
project-detector maps detected tech to public-skill HIGH/MEDIUM tier names. Names listed explicitly so each is independently resolved against deps.json.
